comments.author: Carla
comments.body:
I prefer enver, very good for adventurer/dungeonner and has obstruction as aide skill plus some sailing skills.
ezra has some more battle skills but if you're looking for a maritime aide there are better ones, she has restriction but not seize cargo nor ambush, so not even an useful battle aide.

comments.author: Lancelot
comments.body: Ezra knows more languages, but Enver breeds kitties. Indeed a hard choice.
